
== CreateDatabase acme_x7k2_shop
steps: Create database | Create user | Allow the website container only
long: false
$ install -d -o root -g root -m 0711 $DIR/cf-db $DIR/cf-db/servers $DIR/cf-db/homes
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/cf-db/homes/db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2
$ loginctl enable-linger db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2
$ systemctl start user@10002.service
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/disk
$ install -d -o db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -m 0700 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/disk/data
$ chown root:db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/postgresql.env
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman image exists ghcr.io/cloudfactory/postgresql:latest
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2@ restart cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2.service
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_isready --quiet --host=127.0.0.1 --port=5432 --timeout=5
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE CONNECT ON DATABASE postgres, template1 FROM PUBLIC;
  | DO $$DECLARE r name; BEGIN
  |   FOR r IN SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'cfrestore\_%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = rolname) LOOP
  |     EXECUTE format('DROP ROLE IF EXISTS %I', r);
  |   END LOOP;
  | END$$;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'acme_x7k2_shop' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('acme_x7k2_shop:rw', 'acme_x7k2_shop:ro');
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop:ro" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" OWNER "acme_x7k2_shop:rw";
  | REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'acme_x7k2_shop';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop" LOGIN CONNECTION LIMIT 80 PASSWORD 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | GRANT "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" TO "acme_x7k2_shop";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" SET role = 'acme_x7k2_shop:rw';

== CreateDatabase acme_x7k2_blog
steps: Create database | Create user | Allow the website container only
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'acme_x7k2_blog' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('acme_x7k2_blog:rw', 'acme_x7k2_blog:ro');
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" OWNER "acme_x7k2_blog:rw";
  | REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" TO "acme_x7k2_blog:ro";
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_blog"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "acme_x7k2_blog:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO "acme_x7k2_blog:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "acme_x7k2_blog:ro";

  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;

  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;

== CreateDatabase with no user
steps: Create database
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'acme_x7k2_logs' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('acme_x7k2_logs:rw', 'acme_x7k2_logs:ro');
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_logs:rw" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_logs:ro" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE DATABASE "acme_x7k2_logs" OWNER "acme_x7k2_logs:rw";
  | REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE "acme_x7k2_logs" FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE "acme_x7k2_logs" TO "acme_x7k2_logs:ro";
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_logs"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "acme_x7k2_logs:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_logs:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO "acme_x7k2_logs:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_logs:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "acme_x7k2_logs:ro";

== SetDatabaseUser create
steps: Set user and password | Set access to databases
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'acme_x7k2_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" LOGIN CONNECTION LIMIT 80 PASSWORD 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_shop:ro" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" RESET role;
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" RESET role;
  | GRANT "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" TO "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" SET role = 'acme_x7k2_shop:rw';
  | GRANT "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" TO "acme_x7k2_app";

== SetDatabaseUser change
steps: Set user and password | Set access to databases
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" WITH LOGIN CONNECTION LIMIT 80 PASSWORD 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_shop:ro" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_shop" RESET role;
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" RESET role;
  | GRANT "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" TO "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" SET role = 'acme_x7k2_blog:rw';
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REASSIGN OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_app" TO "acme_x7k2_shop:rw";
  | DROP OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_app";
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT count(pg_terminate_backend(pid)) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = 'acme_x7k2_app' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();

== SetDatabaseUser bad privileges
refused: the database privileges "all" are not valid

== DeleteDatabaseUser
steps: Remove user
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'acme_x7k2_old';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname NOT IN ('postgres', 'template0', 'template1');
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_old" NOLOGIN;
  | SELECT count(pg_terminate_backend(pid)) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = 'acme_x7k2_old' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REASSIGN OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_old" TO "acme_x7k2_shop:rw";
  | DROP OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_old";
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_blog"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REASSIGN OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_old" TO "acme_x7k2_blog:rw";
  | DROP OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_old";
  | DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "acme_x7k2_old";

== Backup
steps: Snapshot files | Dump databases | Upload to object storage | Apply retention
long: true
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_dump --username=postgres --format=custom --no-owner --no-privileges acme_x7k2_shop
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m cat config
$ /usr/local/bin/cf-agent jail --ro $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app --ro $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tmp $DIR/data/restic-tmp -- restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m backup $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tag website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1 --tag kind=manual
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m forget --tag website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1,kind=manual --group-by  --keep-last 3
result dumps: map[postgresql:acme_x7k2_shop:HEX64]
result forgotten: []
result sizeBytes: 2048
result snapshotId: 1a2b3c4d

== Backup of the databases only
steps: Snapshot files | Dump databases | Upload to object storage | Apply retention
long: true
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_dump --username=postgres --format=custom --no-owner --no-privileges acme_x7k2_shop
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m cat config
$ /usr/local/bin/cf-agent jail --ro $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tmp $DIR/data/restic-tmp -- restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m backup $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tag website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1 --tag kind=scheduled-databases
result dumps: map[postgresql:acme_x7k2_shop:HEX64]
result forgotten: []
result sizeBytes: 2048
result snapshotId: 1a2b3c4d

== Restore
steps: Download snapshot | Restore | Health check
long: true
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m snapshots 1a2b3c4d
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m restore 1a2b3c4d --target $DIR/data/restore/01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M2 --include $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2/postgresql-acme_x7k2_shop.dump
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "cfrestore_RANDOM" LOGIN PASSWORD 'HEX24';
  | GRANT "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" TO "cfrestore_RANDOM";
$ chown db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --host=127.0.0.1 --username=cfrestore_RANDOM --dbname=acme_x7k2_shop --no-psqlrc --quiet --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | DO $$DECLARE s name; BEGIN
  |   FOR s IN SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner = '"acme_x7k2_shop:rw"'::regrole AND nspname <> 'public' LOOP
  |     EXECUTE format('DROP SCHEMA %I CASCADE', s);
  |   END LOOP;
  | END$$;
  | DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
  | CREATE SCHEMA public AUTHORIZATION pg_database_owner;
  | REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "acme_x7k2_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "acme_x7k2_shop:ro";
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_restore --host=127.0.0.1 --username=cfrestore_RANDOM --role=acme_x7k2_shop:rw --dbname=acme_x7k2_shop --no-owner --no-privileges --clean --if-exists --exit-on-error
  | DUMP OF acme_x7k2_shop
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "cfrestore_RANDOM";

== Restore with a wrong hash
steps: Download snapshot | Restore | Health check
long: true
error: the dump does not agree with the hash from the backup

$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m restore 1a2b3c4d --target $DIR/data/restore/01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M2 --include $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2/postgresql-acme_x7k2_shop.dump

== databaseSizes
postgresql acme_x7k2_shop 4096
postgresql acme_x7k2_blog 8192
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT datname || '|' || pg_database_size(datname) FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate;

== DeleteDatabase
steps: Remove access of users | Remove database
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" FROM "acme_x7k2_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_app" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" RESET role;
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:rw" FROM "acme_x7k2_blog";
  | REVOKE "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" FROM "acme_x7k2_blog";
  | ALTER ROLE "acme_x7k2_blog" IN DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" RESET role;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname NOT IN ('postgres', 'template0', 'template1');
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'acme_x7k2_blog:rw';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | DO $$BEGIN
  |   IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'acme_x7k2_blog') THEN
  |     EXECUTE 'ALTER DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" IS_TEMPLATE false';
  |     EXECUTE 'ALTER DATABASE "acme_x7k2_blog" RESET ALL';
  |   END IF;
  | END$$;
  | \connect "acme_x7k2_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REASSIGN OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_blog:rw", "acme_x7k2_blog:ro" TO "acme_x7k2_shop:rw";
  | DROP OWNED BY "acme_x7k2_blog:rw", "acme_x7k2_blog:ro";
  | \connect postgres
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "acme_x7k2_blog" WITH (FORCE);
  | DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "acme_x7k2_blog:rw";
  | DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "acme_x7k2_blog:ro";

== move secret
path: $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/postgresql.env
"MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=00112233\nMYSQL_PWD=00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the postgresql superuser is not valid
"POSTGRES_PASSWORD=00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the postgresql superuser is not valid
"00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the postgresql superuser is not valid
"MYSQL_PWD=00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the postgresql superuser is not valid
"POSTGRES_PASSWORD=0011\nOTHER=1\n": line 1 of the secret of the postgresql superuser is not valid
"": line 1 of the secret of the postgresql superuser is not valid
